newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy BTP LIFFE future at new peak, spread narrows.
newsitem.headline: Italy BTP LIFFE future at new peak, spread narrows.

text.p: The September BTP futures contract on LIFFE rose to a new record of 134.90 in the European morning, helped by optimism over European convergence and gains in other markets.
The yield spread of the benchmark 10-year February 2007 Btp over the benchmark 10-year Bund was 109 basis points, its narrowest gap ever.
The Feb07 Btp was 41 basis points up on the day at 100.73 with the yield at 6.74 percent.
The Sept LIF future was 48 basis points up on the day at 134.88 0836 GMT.
